findings.title: Shard queries are interpolated again during execution
findings.body: These targets are interpolated here before shard discovery, but each generated shard request is later passed to `runSplitQuery`, which also calls `applyTemplateVariables` on every target (querySplitting.ts:299). This means a value produced by interpolation can be interpreted as template syntax on the second pass, changing the query sent to Loki; for example, a variable value containing `$name` may be expanded again instead of being queried literally. Avoid applying template variables in both stages, or ensure the nested execution path knows the targets are already interpolated.
